Name: Fruit Tree Puddings Continued
Author: Shads4242
Description:
[b][size=4][center]About[/center][/size][/b]

Fruit Tree Puddings Continued is a port of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13986]Fruit Tree Puddings[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Lavliette?gameId=1303]Lavliette[/url]﻿, made with their permission. This port is designed to use content patcher and the Cornucopia family of mods , although compatibility for other mod families is coming in the future!

[b][size=4][center]Features[/center][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]27 pudding recipes - each one is made with 1 large milk, 1 sugar, and 3 fruits
[*]4 new pudding recipes - Banana, Plantain, Nectarine, and Coconut 
[*]Dynamic addition of recipes - which puddings you can make depends on which Cornucopia mod and enabled mod configs you're currently playing with [b](Only available when Love of Cooking is not installed)[/b]
[/list]
[b][size=4][center]FAQ[/center][/size]

Q1: How do I install this mod?
A:[/b] Follow the steps below. 
[list=1]
[*]Download the mod from Nexus
[*]Unzip the mod and place in your Mods folder
[*]Have fun :)
[/list]
[b]Q2: I need to report a bug, how do I do that?
A:[/b] Open a bug report on the bugs page. Be sure to include a SMAPI log so that way I can more easily diagnose and fix the issue

[b]Q3: Is this compatible with Love of Cooking?
A:[/b] Yes, but there is an additional requirement. If you are using Love of Cooking, having Cornucopia More Crops installed [i]and [/i]enabling the Extended Trees config option [b][u]is required[/u][/b]. This is due to the only workaround I've found for making LOC compatible mods being a simplified cooking.json file that doesn't include when clauses. If I can figure out how to fix this so I can do the dynamic recipe addition I will add that in a new version. 

If you do not have Love of Cooking installed, you can safely play this mod with or without Cornucopia installed.

[center][size=4]
[b]Translations[/b][/size][/center]

If you want to translate this mod, please feel free to do so! Send me your i18n file afterwards and I'll upload it as part of the main mod. You'll be credited as the author of the file on the mod page and in the code itself.

Downloads.Description: Perform a clean install. Replace any version of "Fruit Tree Puddings" or "Fruit Tree Puddings Continued" with this mod.
